question: Does strong cross-family trait-order reconfiguration persist when each trait pair is compared on exactly the same species and exactly the same phylogenetic tree within each family?
population: AusTraits matched positive-numeric log core from the prospectively qualified final core.

trait_pair_selection.rule: Select unordered trait pairs that co-occur in at least 10 families in the fixed matched-log family-trait graph.

within_family_pair.species_state: source-native species median under the frozen numeric unit contract, natural-log transformed after strict positivity
within_family_pair.shared_species: intersection of valid species states for trait A and trait B in the same family
within_family_pair.phylogeny: build one V.PhyloMaker2 S3 tree from the shared species list; both traits use this identical tree
within_family_pair.effect: for each trait separately, Spearman(all unordered patristic distances, absolute log-state differences) on the identical tip set

outputs.paired_species_reversal: cross-family pair-order reversal probability using paired-species rho
outputs.original_restricted_reversal: the frozen original matched-log rho reversal, restricted to exactly the family x trait-pair cells that pass the paired-species support gate
outputs.order_change_after_species_matching: fraction of eligible family x trait-pair cells whose rho_A-rho_B sign changes after enforcing identical species sets
outputs.support: numbers of eligible trait pairs, family-pair cells, shared species, S3 tips and prune tips

interpretation.reversal_persists: species-set/subtree mismatch is not a simple explanation of lineage-specific trait re-ordering
interpretation.reversal_collapses: the biological re-wiring interpretation is substantially weakened; differential species sampling among traits explains much of the apparent re-ordering

role: post-outcome exploratory robustness test; cannot reclassify the prospective AusTraits rank-portability result
hard_nonclaims: Passing this test does not identify an ecological or developmental mechanism.
The common-species subset can change the biological species sample and therefore estimates a stricter matched-sample estimand.
Do not lower the 20-tip support gates based on the result.
